hook: This electric BMW M3 packs 838 horsepower into four independent motors.

sections.voiceover: This electric BMW M3 packs 838 horsepower into four independent motors.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of the BMW M3 emblem on an electric prototype vehicle.
sections.sfx_cue: Electric motor whine rising in pitch.
b_roll: Exterior shot of BMW M3 electric prototype at Miramas proving ground

sections.voiceover: Can these four motors manage 1,200 Nm of torque during testing at the Miramas proving ground?
sections.visual_cue: Map showing Miramas location in France followed by a diagram of four motors.
sections.sfx_cue: Mechanical click sound as motors appear in the diagram.
b_roll: Aerial view of Miramas proving ground

sections.voiceover: But Car and Driver reveals the front-axle motors alone generate 644 horsepower for this electric M3.
sections.visual_cue: Technical schematic highlighting the 800-volt battery pack components.
b_roll: Close up of internal high voltage battery components

sections.voiceover: BMWBlog reports the 100-kWh battery pack fuels the 838 horsepower generated by these four electric motors. This quad-motor design gives the electric M3 independent wheel control using an 800-volt architecture.
sections.visual_cue: Graph showing front axle power output versus total vehicle output.
b_roll: BMW M3 prototype cornering on a track

sections.voiceover: The final design integrates these four motors with a high-capacity 100-kWh battery pack.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of the BMW M3 prototype parked at the track.
